notes: «وقال الليث حدثني عقيل» opens a second route; the names «قال ابن شهاب فأخبرني عروة بن الزبير، أن عائشة» are written once after it and are read as the shared tail (rule 3)
the route through «معمر» ends where the text stops naming, so it takes the same tail; the text does not repeat the names for it
the Companion «عائشة» is the last link; her words are the saying
